title: Istanbul to İzmir: 1-Hour Flight vs 4.5-Hour Highway via Osmangazi Bridge
seoTitle: Istanbul to İzmir: Flight vs O-5 Toll Highway (2026)
metaDescription: Compare 1-hour IST–ADB flights with the 4.5-hour O-5 drive, 2026 Osmangazi Bridge tolls, Bursa and Ayvalık stops, and İzmir İZBAN airport rail.
quickAnswer: Flying 60–70 minutes from IST or SAW to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB) is the fastest istanbul to izmir transport option for solo business or city trips, taking 3.5 to 4 hours door-to-door. Driving the O-5 toll highway via the Osmangazi Bridge takes 4.5 to 5.5 hours and suits groups heading onward to Çeşme, Urla, or Ephesus.
category: Inner Pages — 20 Point-to-Point Transport, Stopover & Route Logistics Guides

body.text: Is flying IST–ADB faster door-to-door than driving the O-5 toll highway?

Flying IST or SAW to ADB is roughly 60 to 90 minutes faster door-to-door for central city-to-city trips, totaling around 3.5 to 4 hours once you include Istanbul airport transit, check-in, and the İZBAN rail ride into Alsancak or Konak. From Istanbul's Asian side, however, driving the O-5 motorway can come remarkably close in total door-to-door time.

If you are staying in Kadıköy or Ataşehir and travelling onward to Urla, Alaçatı, or Çeşme, leaving at 06:30 by car avoids two airport security queues, baggage claim, and a rental-car counter wait at ADB. Conversely, if you are based in Beyoğlu, Şişli, or Sultanahmet and attending meetings in central İzmir, taking a direct Turkish Airlines flight from IST or a [Pegasus](https://www.flypgs.com/en/domestic-flights) / [AJet](https://ajet.com/en-tr/flights-from-istanbul-to-denizli) departure from SAW removes highway fatigue and Bosphorus bridge delays.
How much are 2026 Osmangazi Bridge and O-5 highway tolls?

Under the official tariff effective July 1, 2026, a Class 1 passenger car pays 1,170 TL to cross the [Osmangazi Bridge](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/SiteCollectionDocuments/KGMdocuments/Otoyollar/OtoyolKopruUcret/2026Gecis_Ucret/2_OSMANGAZ%C4%B0_BRIDGE_ENG.pdf) and 2,525 TL total for the complete Gebze–Orhangazi–İzmir O-5 motorway corridor (1,170 TL bridge + 1,355 TL highway section), as confirmed in [2026 KGM and operator tariff schedules](https://www.isbank.com.tr/blog/2026-kopru-ve-otoyol-ucretleri).

Class 2 vehicles (such as minibuses and larger passenger vans) pay 1,870 TL on the Osmangazi Bridge and 4,040 TL for the full O-5 corridor. All crossings are cashless via Türkiye's [HGS electronic toll system](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteEng/Root/HGSeng.aspx); drivers departing from Istanbul's European side also pay 59 TL on the 15 July Martyrs or Fatih Sultan Mehmet bridges (or 110 TL on the Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge). Always verify your exact entry-and-exit segment fee on the [Otoyol A.Ş. toll calculator](https://isletme.otoyolas.com.tr/gecis-ucreti-hesapla/), and settle any unpaid HGS balance within 15 days via the [Otoyol A.Ş. violation portal](https://isletme.otoyolas.com.tr/ihlalli-gecis-sorgula/) to avoid a fourfold administrative fine.

body.text: Which stops (Bursa, Susurluk, Ayvalık) make the drive rewarding?

Three natural detours turn the O-5 transit into an enjoyable west-coast road day: Bursa (roughly 1.5 hours from Istanbul's Asian side) for historic Ottoman bazaars and İskender kebab, Susurluk (just past the halfway mark) for quick roadside toast and frothy ayran breaks, and Ayvalık (a 45-minute coastal detour west of the motorway) for stone-house alleys and olive-oil tavernas.

Bursa sits directly alongside the O-5 (Gebze to Bursa Kuzey costs 1,540 TL including the Osmangazi Bridge for Class 1 cars), making a two-hour lunch stop effortless. Susurluk's motorway service plazas require zero detour and keep total driving time under five hours. Ayvalık and Cunda Island work best if you add an overnight stay rather than rushing back to the motorway for a late-night İzmir check-in.
How does İzmir İZBAN rail connect ADB to city center?

The [İZBAN suburban rail line](https://www.izban.com.tr/sayfalar/SeferSaatleri.aspx?MenuId=22) connects directly to [İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB)](https://izmirairport.com/en/transports/subway-metro) via a covered pedestrian walkway from the domestic terminal, running north to Hilal, Alsancak, and Halkapınar in roughly 25 to 30 minutes. Trains operate roughly every 15 to 20 minutes from early morning until around midnight, bypassing highway congestion completely.

For hotels in Konak or Çankaya, change smoothly from İZBAN onto the [İzmir Metro](https://www.izmir.bel.tr/en/lost-property-offices-in-urban-transport/504/3193) at Hilal or Halkapınar interchange stations. If you are heading south straight from ADB to Selçuk (Ephesus), İZBAN also runs southbound to Tepeköy, where you transfer to a local shuttle train to Selçuk—or board a direct regional TCDD train from the airport station.

items: Confirm your rental car's HGS sticker is active before entering the O-5 toll corridor.
Leave Istanbul before 07:00 or after 10:00 on weekdays to clear Gebze and Bosphorus bridge bottlenecks.
Purchase an İzmirim Kart or tap a contactless bank card at the ADB İZBAN turnstiles for fast rail boarding.
Check whether your final destination is central İzmir (fly + İZBAN) or Çeşme/Alaçatı (flying + rental at ADB or direct O-5 drive).

faq.q: How much is the Osmangazi Bridge toll in 2026 for a standard car?
faq.a: As of July 1, 2026, the Class 1 passenger car toll on the Osmangazi Bridge is 1,170 TL each way, and the full Gebze–İzmir O-5 corridor including the bridge totals 2,525 TL.

faq.q: Can you pay O-5 motorway tolls with cash or credit card?
faq.a: Tolls on the Osmangazi Bridge and O-5 motorway are collected electronically via HGS; rental cars include an HGS tag and bill your accumulated tolls back to your card after return.

faq.q: How long does İZBAN take from İzmir Airport to Alsancak?
faq.a: The İZBAN train from Adnan Menderes Airport station reaches Hilal in about 23–25 minutes and Alsancak in roughly 28–30 minutes, avoiding road traffic.

faq.q: Is driving from Istanbul to İzmir faster than taking the ferry to Bandırma?
faq.a: Yes. Driving via the Osmangazi Bridge and O-5 motorway takes 4.5 to 5.5 hours without ferry check-in waits or rough-sea cancellations, whereas the Yenikapı–Bandırma ferry plus drive typically takes longer door-to-door.

faq.q: Which Istanbul airport has more flights to İzmir?
faq.a: Both IST (Turkish Airlines) and SAW (Pegasus and AJet) offer frequent daily non-stop flights to İzmir (ADB), with combined departures running almost every hour throughout the day.

faq.q: Is Susurluk directly on the O-5 motorway?
faq.a: Yes. Susurluk sits directly on the O-5 corridor between Bursa and Balıkesir, with modern motorway rest plazas where you can stop for food and fuel without leaving the highway.
